title: Listening Drill — Evening history course — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Evening history course — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on evening history course last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with quiet voices. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: faulty projector.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of seat position so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow course notes instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the course leader before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Monday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
